1817241.text: Artiva is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing off-the-shelf natural killer (NK) cell therapies for autoimmune diseases and cancers. Its lead product candidate, AlloNK, is being evaluated in three ongoing clinical trials, with refractory rheumatoid arthritis as the lead indication.

1819848.text: JOBY develops piloted, all-electric eVTOL aircraft designed to transport a pilot and up to four passengers at 200 mph speeds with up to 100-mile range. JOBY plans to operate air taxi services in markets including the United States and Dubai, and pursue aircraft sales. It operates manufacturing facilities in California and Ohio.

1819994.text: Rocket Lab is an end-to-end space company offering Electron launch services, spacecraft design and components, spacecraft manufacturing and optical systems, and is developing the Neutron launch vehicle. It operates launch complexes in Mahia, New Zealand and Wallops Island, Virginia. Its customers include U.S. government agencies such as NASA, the NRO and DARPA, and commercial spacecraft operators.

1821769.text: Navitas Semiconductor (NVTS) designs gallium nitride and silicon carbide power semiconductors, including power ICs, SiC devices and digital isolators, and contracts manufacturing to partner suppliers. It focuses on AI data centers, energy and grid infrastructure, performance computing and industrial electrification. Operations span the U.S., Ireland, Germany, Italy, Belgium, China, Taiwan, Thailand, South Korea and the Philippines.

1822966.text: NuScale Power (SMR) is developing its NuScale Power Module small modular reactor technology and related services, including licensing support, testing, training and fuel supply. Its customers are a mix of governments, utilities, state-owned enterprises and technology and industrial companies. It has been working with RoPower Nuclear in Romania and prospective customer ENTRA1.

1824502.text: Archer Aviation is developing the Midnight electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft for air taxi operations, plus a dual-use VTOL aircraft with Anduril for defense and commercial use. It plans commercial operations in U.S. cities and the UAE, and is offering aircraft through a Launch Edition program to governments and customers.

1824920.text: IonQ is a quantum computing platform company developing quantum computers and related networking, sensing, and security products. It offers quantum-computing-as-a-service through AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud platforms, and provides professional services.

1828108.text: Aurora Innovation develops the Aurora Driver, a self-driving technology platform for autonomous vehicles. Founded in 2017, the company focuses initially on trucking, with plans to expand to passenger mobility and local goods delivery. Aurora partners with major vehicle manufacturers and logistics companies and operates in the United States.

1828318.text: Enovix is a battery company developing and manufacturing silicon-anode lithium-ion batteries for smartphones, smart eyewear, defense, industrial and edge-AI applications. Its manufacturing and R&D are conducted primarily in Malaysia, South Korea and India, with corporate functions at its U.S. headquarters. Its customers include mobile OEMs, smart eyewear customers, and defense and industrial customers.

1829864.text: TaskUs provides outsourced digital customer experience, trust and safety, and AI services, including data annotation and LLM support. Its clients, about 200 as of December 31, 2025, include global companies in AI, autonomous vehicles, social media, financial services and healthcare. It operates 31 sites in 13 countries.

1836754.text: Legacy Education owns accredited career colleges in California, offering healthcare and other career programs. The colleges are High Desert Medical College, Central Coast College, Integrity College of Health and Contra Costa Medical Career College. Its target students are early- to mid-20-year-olds, mainly living within a 100-mile radius of each campus.

1838359.text: RGTI develops superconducting quantum computers and provides cloud-based and on-premises quantum computing services. It serves commercial enterprises and government organizations including AWS, DOE, and DARPA, operating from facilities in the U.S., UK, and India.

1838406.text: BKV is an energy company focused on natural gas production, natural gas midstream, natural gas-fired power generation and carbon capture (CCUS). It operates in Texas, including the Barnett Shale, where its BKV Energy unit sells electricity to commercial, industrial and residential customers.

1838413.text: Full Truck Alliance is a Cayman Islands holding company whose operations are conducted primarily in China, through contractual arrangements with variable interest entities and through subsidiaries. Its ADSs are listed on the NYSE under the ticker 'YMM'.

1840856.text: SoundHound offers independent Voice AI technology, including its Houndify developer platform, Smart Answering and Smart Ordering products, and an AI agent platform. Its customers are product creators in automotive, TV and IoT, and customer service businesses, including restaurants.

1844862.text: Solid Power is a U.S.-based developer of solid-state battery technology, focused on a sulfide-based solid electrolyte it manufactures and sells. It sells electrolyte to Tier 1 battery manufacturers and automotive OEMs that produce their own cells. It collaborates with BMW, Samsung SDI and SK On.

1845840.text: Telesat is a global satellite operator providing satellite communications services for voice, data and broadcast in the Americas, including Canada's far North, and is building the Telesat Lightspeed LEO satellite network for enterprise and government customers. It also operates Telesat Government Solutions, a U.S. government-approved subsidiary.

1849635.text: TMTG operates Truth Social, a social media platform, and Truth+, a TV streaming platform with live TV channels and on-demand content. It also operates Truth.Fi, a financial services and FinTech brand that includes a digital asset strategy with a bitcoin treasury.

18498.text: Genesco is a retailer and wholesaler of branded footwear, apparel and accessories, operating through Journeys, Schuh, Johnston & Murphy and Genesco Brands. Its retail stores are located primarily in the US and Puerto Rico, with additional stores in Canada, the UK and the Republic of Ireland. Its wholesale customers include department, discount and specialty stores and e-commerce retailers.

1865631.text: NextNav provides positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) solutions using a ground-based transmitter network on low-band spectrum covered by its FCC licenses, plus its Pinnacle altitude service. Pinnacle is delivered via API or SDK to mass-market, enterprise, and public safety applications. It plans partnerships with mobile network operators.

1866175.text: Crescent Energy develops and produces oil, natural gas and natural gas liquids. It operates upstream assets in the United States and owns a 12% interest in the Springfield Gathering System in southeast Texas's Eagle Ford Shale.

1867096.name: Xeris Biopharma Holdings, Inc.
1867096.text: Xeris is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company that sells Recorlev, Gvoke, and Keveyis, and is developing XP-8121, a once-weekly subcutaneous levothyroxine. It develops and commercializes therapies for people with chronic endocrine and neurological diseases in the United States.

1873951.text: Exzeo provides insurance technology and operations software, through its Exzeo Platform, to property and casualty (P&C) insurance carriers and their agents. The platform covers underwriting, policy administration, claims management and reporting. Services are currently provided in 13 U.S. states, including Florida and Utah.

1874315.text: Satellogic is a vertically integrated Earth observation company that designs, manufactures and operates satellites, selling high-resolution imagery and analytics such as its Aleph Observer monitoring service. It serves government and commercial customers and assembles its satellites in Montevideo, Uruguay.

1876183.name: IHS Holding Ltd
1876183.text: IHS owns, operates and develops shared communications infrastructure, operating 37,590 towers as of December 31, 2025 across five African countries and two Latin American countries. Its customers are mostly leading mobile network operators (MNOs), and its towers support coverage for approximately 647 million people in emerging markets.

1879016.text: Ivanhoe Electric (IE) is a United States minerals exploration and development company focused on copper and other critical metals. Its wholly owned assets are in the United States, where its sole material project is the Santa Cruz Copper Project in Arizona. It also operates exploration joint ventures in Saudi Arabia, Chile and the United States.

1891027.text: MNTN provides a self-serve PTV software platform that lets marketers plan, target, measure and optimize connected TV (CTV) advertising campaigns toward goals such as ROAS. Its customers are brands of many sizes, with a focus on mid-sized and small businesses, many new to TV advertising. Its campaigns reach CTV households across the United States.

1897762.text: Ingm is an IT solutions provider supplying technology products and services across four global segments. It delivers solutions to vendor and reseller partners through its B2B platform, offering client endpoint solutions, advanced enterprise solutions, cloud-based offerings and logistics services.

1899287.text: Amprius develops, manufactures and markets silicon-anode lithium-ion batteries for mobility uses, mainly aviation such as drones and high-altitude pseudo satellites. Its batteries have been validated by customers including AeroVironment, BAE Systems, Teledyne FLIR and the U.S. Army. Its principal offices are in Fremont, California.

1907085.text: Oddity runs an online, direct-to-consumer beauty and wellness business through brands including IL MAKIAGE, SpoiledChild and METHODIQ, a telehealth platform. It sells to consumers online in the United States, the U.K., continental Europe and Australia, and its R&D center is in Tel Aviv, Israel.

1907982.text: D-Wave provides commercial annealing and gate-model quantum computing systems, software, and services. The company offers quantum computers with sub-second response times deployable on-premises or accessed through its Leap cloud service. D-Wave serves enterprise customers solving complex computational problems.

1922446.text: Diversified Energy (DEC) produces natural gas, NGLs and oil from mature assets. Its operations are in the Appalachian Region (Ohio, Pennsylvania, Virginia, West Virginia, Kentucky, Tennessee, Alabama) and Central Region (Texas, Oklahoma, New Mexico, Louisiana, Arkansas), plus Florida and Wyoming. It delivers natural gas to various customers under contracts.

1922641.text: Enlight Renewable Energy is a global renewable energy platform that develops, finances, builds, owns and operates utility-scale wind, solar and energy storage projects. It primarily generates revenue from selling electricity under long-term power purchase agreements. It operates in 11 countries in Europe, the U.S., Morocco and Israel, and sells electricity to corporate customers in Israel.

1930313.text: SBC Medical Group is a management company that provides management services to aesthetic clinics in Japan, including advertising, staffing, procurement, IT solutions and licensing of medical technologies and trademarks. It also owns and operates clinics in Vietnam and Singapore, with offices in Irvine, California and Tokyo, Japan. Its revenue comes mainly from franchisee cosmetic treatment centers.

1932393.text: GE HealthCare is a global healthcare solutions provider of medical devices, pharmaceutical diagnostics, and AI-enabled cloud and software solutions. It operates in over 160 countries through four segments: Imaging, Advanced Visualization Solutions, Patient Care Solutions, and Pharmaceutical Diagnostics. Customers include hospitals, health systems, and research institutions.

1956955.text: Unusual Machines makes drone components and drones under the Unusual Machines, Rotor Riot and Fat Shark brands. It sells business-to-business to drone manufacturers and system integrators, and direct-to-consumer through its Rotor Riot e-commerce platform. Its principal place of business is in Orlando, Florida.

1958086.text: Core Lab provides proprietary reservoir description and production enhancement services and products to the oil and gas industry, including laboratory analysis of reservoir rock and fluids. It has over 70 offices in more than 50 countries. Its clients are primarily major, national and independent oil companies.

19584.text: Che operates VITAS, which provides hospice and palliative care services primarily in Florida through Medicare. Roto-Rooter, its second segment, provides plumbing, drain cleaning and water restoration services to residential and commercial customers in the United States.

1964738.text: Solventum is a global healthcare company with three segments: MedSurg solutions (wound care, surgical supplies), Dental Solutions (orthodontics and restorative products), and Health Information Systems (healthcare software). It serves hospitals, clinics, and healthcare systems.

1969373.text: Vesta owns, develops, manages and leases industrial parks and buildings in Mexico. As of December 31, 2025, it had 231 buildings across sixteen Mexican states. Its clients use its light-manufacturing and logistics facilities.

1973239.text: Arm licenses CPU IP, GPU IP, systems IP, compute subsystems and associated software and tools to semiconductor companies. Its end markets include smartphones, PCs, consumer electronics, industrial devices and data centers. Its registered office is in Cambridge, UK, with a US subsidiary in San Jose, California.

1973266.text: TKO is a premium sports and entertainment company operating UFC, WWE, and Professional Bull Riders, along with sports marketing agency IMG and experiential hospitality business On Location. Its properties reach over 1 billion households across 210 countries. Revenue sources include media rights licensing, live events, partnerships with major brands, and consumer products.

1977102.text: Birk designs and manufactures footwear products featuring its iconic footbed, with production and assembly in Germany and the EU. It sells globally through direct-to-consumer retail and e-commerce channels as well as wholesale partnerships to consumers worldwide.

1980088.text: Mach Natural Resources (MNR) is an oil and natural gas company with proved reserves and drilled wells. Its sponsor is Bayou City Energy Management funds.

1980845.text: enGene is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing non-viral genetic medicines using its DDX gene delivery platform. Its lead product candidate, detalimogene, is in development as a monotherapy for BCG-unresponsive non-muscle invasive bladder cancer with carcinoma in situ.

1985273.text: TOYO is an early-stage solar company that produces solar cells and plans to produce solar PV modules. It has solar cell plants in Vietnam and Ethiopia and a Texas facility that began commercial production in October 2025. TOYO is headquartered in Japan and has supply agreements with over 50 third-party solar cell customers.

200406.text: Johnson & Johnson researches, develops, and manufactures healthcare products through two segments: Innovative Medicine (pharmaceuticals for oncology, immunology, and other therapeutic areas) and MedTech (medical devices for cardiovascular, orthopedic, surgical, and vision care). Products are distributed to healthcare professionals, hospitals, and retailers worldwide.

2007596.text: TWFG is an independent distribution platform for personal and commercial insurance, providing independent agencies with carrier access, technology, training and M&A support. It is licensed in all 50 states, with much of its business concentrated in Texas, California and Louisiana, and works with over 300 insurance carriers.

2023554.name: Sandisk Corp
2023554.text: Sandisk is a global semiconductor memory company that makes NAND flash products, including solid-state drives, embedded products, removable cards, USB drives and wafers. Its customers include datacenter and cloud service providers, OEMs, channel partners and consumers.

2025410.text: StandardAero provides aerospace engine aftermarket services, including maintenance, repair and overhaul, component repair and field service for fixed and rotary wing aircraft. It serves commercial, military and business aviation markets, with customers including engine OEMs and about 5,000 customers globally. Operations span the United States, Canada, the UK and several other countries.

2029118.text: Infinity is an independent energy company focused on acquiring, developing and producing oil and natural gas in the Appalachian Basin. Its operations are in the Utica Shale in eastern Ohio and in the Marcellus and Utica Shales in southwestern Pennsylvania.

2035149.text: Flowco provides production optimization, artificial lift and emissions management equipment for oil and natural gas wells, including gas lift and vapor recovery units. Its operations are in the U.S., with facilities across major onshore producing regions. Its customers include large oil and natural gas producers.

2035304.text: Titan America is a vertically integrated producer of heavy building materials, including cement, aggregates, ready-mix concrete, concrete block and fly ash. It operates primarily in Florida, Metro New York, Virginia, North Carolina and South Carolina. Its concrete block customers include retail home improvement stores and masonry contractors.

2035989.text: Amrize is a North American building solutions company offering cement, aggregates, ready-mix concrete, roofing systems, and wall solutions. The company operates more than 1,000 sites across the United States, Canada, Colombia, Switzerland, and Jamaica, serving more than 23,000 customers in infrastructure, commercial, and residential construction.

2036042.name: Sionna Therapeutics, Inc.
2036042.text: Sionna is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing small-molecule medicines for cystic fibrosis that stabilize the NBD1 domain of the CFTR protein. Its lead candidate, SION-719, is in a Phase 2a trial in CF patients, alongside complementary CFTR modulator candidates.

2040127.name: Karman Holdings Inc.
2040127.text: Karman designs, tests, manufactures and sells mission-critical systems for missile, defense and space programs, including payload protection, interstage and propulsion systems. It serves prime contractor customers in hypersonics and strategic missile defense, tactical missiles, integrated defense systems, and space and launch markets.

2044725.text: Evommune (EVMN) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing therapies for chronic inflammatory diseases. Its Phase 2 candidates are EVO756, an oral MRGPRX2 antagonist, and EVO301, an IL-18 binding fusion protein. Initial indications are chronic spontaneous urticaria, atopic dermatitis and ulcerative colitis.

2067876.text: Versant operates television networks including CNBC, USA Network, Golf Channel, E!, SYFY and Oxygen, along with digital platforms GolfNow, Fandango and Rotten Tomatoes. The company generates revenue through network distribution, advertising, digital platform services and content licensing, serving audiences, advertisers and distributors primarily in the United States.

2079999.text: Cardinal is an infrastructure services contractor providing wet utility installations (water, sewer and stormwater systems), grading, site clearing, paving and related site work. It serves residential, commercial, industrial, municipal and state infrastructure markets. It describes itself as a full-service infrastructure services company in the Southeastern United States.

2099039.text: Wise Group provides cross-border payment and money transfer services through Wise Account (individuals), Wise Business (SMBs), and Wise Platform (banks and institutions). Headquartered in London, the company operates globally with offices spanning North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. It served 18.9 million customers in fiscal 2026.

21535.text: Cohu supplies semiconductor test automation, interface solutions, inspection and metrology equipment, and software analytics to optimize semiconductor manufacturing yield. Its customers include OSATs and fabless semiconductor companies, and its installed base serves customers in 31 countries.

21665.text: Colgate-Palmolive manufactures and sells oral care products like toothpaste and mouthwash, personal care items including soaps and deodorants, and home care products such as dishwashing liquids and cleaners. Through Hill's Pet Nutrition, it markets specialty pet foods. The company sells to retailers, wholesalers, distributors and veterinarians in over 200 countries.

217410.text: Unilever is a consumer goods company with brands such as Dove and Vaseline, spanning personal care and foods. Its Ice Cream business was demerged as The Magnum Ice Cream Company, in which Unilever retains a 19.85% stake. It sells through retailers and operates in markets including the US, Latin America and India.

27419.text: Target is a retail company offering fashionable, differentiated merchandise and everyday essentials at discounted prices through stores and digital channels. The company sells general merchandise, groceries and owned brand products, with approximately half of merchandise sourced from outside the United States.

275053.text: Nature's Sunshine (NATR) is a natural health and wellness company that manufactures and direct-sells over 800 nutritional and personal care products. It sells through independent consultants who use the products or resell them to consumers. It operates in Asia, Europe, North America, and Latin America and Other.

277135.text: Grainger is a distributor of maintenance, repair and operating (MRO) products and services operating in North America, Japan and recently exited the UK. It serves over 4.6 million customers ranging from small businesses to large corporations and government entities through high-touch solutions and online platforms like Zoro and MonotaRO.

277948.text: CSX is a railroad transportation company based in Jacksonville, Florida operating a 20,000 route-mile network across 26 eastern U.S. states and Canadian provinces. It provides freight transportation services including rail, intermodal and coal transport. CSX serves manufacturers, automotive companies, retailers, farmers, energy producers and other businesses.

278166.text: Cavco designs and manufactures factory-built homes, park model RVs, and commercial structures through 33 production lines in the United States and Mexico. It distributes through independent retailers and 92 company-owned stores in 48 states and Canada, serving homebuyers, developers, and community operators.

29534.name: DOLLAR GENERAL CORP
29534.text: Dollar General is a discount retailer offering consumable, seasonal, home, and apparel products, including national and private brands at everyday low prices, mostly typically $10 or less. It operates 20,959 small-box stores in 48 U.S. states and Mexico as of February 27, 2026. Its customers are shoppers seeking basic everyday and household needs.

29644.text: Donaldson is a global filtration company providing air, fuel, hydraulic, and industrial filtration products for mobile, industrial, and life sciences applications. It operates across six continents with manufacturing and distribution centers, serving OEMs and distributors in construction, mining, agriculture, transportation, aerospace, and data center industries.

313616.text: DHR is a science and technology company with three segments: Biotechnology, Life Sciences, and Diagnostics. It provides equipment, consumables, and services to pharmaceutical companies, research institutions, and manufacturers globally across approximately 50 countries.

313838.name: Sony Group Corp
313838.text: Sony operates business segments including Game & Network Services, Music, Pictures, Entertainment Technology & Services, and Imaging & Sensing Solutions. Its products include consumer electronics and image sensors, and it competes in games, music, pictures and entertainment content.

313927.text: Church & Dwight develops and markets consumer household and personal care products under brands including ARM & HAMMER and OXICLEAN, plus specialty products for animal and food production. The company operates in the United States and internationally across Canada, Europe, Australia, and Japan, selling through supermarkets, mass merchandisers, and drugstores.

315374.text: Hurco designs, manufactures and sells computer numeric control (CNC) machine tools, mainly vertical machining centers and turning centers, along with software options, parts and services. It has sales and service subsidiaries in countries including China, Germany, Italy and the U.S., and manufacturing in Taiwan, the U.S. and Italy. Its customers are companies in the metal cutting industry.

31791.text: RVTY provides health science solutions including reagents, instruments, assay platforms and software across Life Sciences and Diagnostics segments. The company operates in more than 160 countries, serving pharmaceutical, biotech, research organizations, hospitals and clinicians.

318154.text: Amgen discovers, develops, manufactures and delivers innovative medicines for diseases with high unmet medical need. The company is one of the world's leading independent biotechnology companies. Its medicines address cardiovascular, rare disease and oncology indications.

319201.text: KLA supplies process control equipment and services for semiconductor manufacturing and electronic device production. It serves semiconductor and electronic device manufacturers globally through three segments: Semiconductor Process Control, Specialty Semiconductor Process, and PCB and Component Inspection.

320187.text: Nike designs and markets athletic footwear, apparel, equipment, and accessories under Nike, Jordan, and Converse brands. It sells through wholesale accounts and Nike Direct operations including retail stores and digital platforms across North America, Europe, Middle East & Africa, Greater China, and Asia Pacific & Latin America.

320193.text: Apple designs and manufactures smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables, and accessories, along with digital services including the App Store, Apple Music, and Apple Pay. It operates globally across the Americas, Europe, Greater China, Japan, and Rest of Asia Pacific. Apple serves consumers, small and mid-sized businesses, education, enterprise, and government customers.

353278.text: NVO is a global healthcare company and world leader in obesity and diabetes care. It manufactures and markets GLP-1 receptor agonists, insulins, and rare disease pharmaceuticals in approximately 170 countries.

354950.text: Home Depot is the world's largest home improvement retailer, offering home improvement products, building materials and installation services. It operates 2,359 stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico, serving homeowners and professional contractors.

355811.text: Gentex designs and manufactures automatic-dimming rearview mirrors using electrochromic technology for automotive applications, along with premium audio systems, dimmable aircraft windows, fire protection devices, and medical devices. It operates globally with sales, engineering and distribution locations supporting all major automotive producing regions and serves automotive manufacturers, consumer electronics companies, and aviation customers.

37996.text: Ford is a global automaker based in Dearborn, Michigan, selling Ford and Lincoln trucks, SUVs, vans, cars and EVs, plus connected services and financing through Ford Credit. Its Ford Model e operates in North America, Europe and China, and Ford Pro in North America and Europe. Customers include retail, commercial, government and rental buyers.

39911.name: GAP INC
39911.text: Gap Inc. is an omni-channel apparel retailer offering apparel, accessories, and personal care products for men, women, and children under the Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic, and Athleta brands. It operates Company-operated stores in the United States, Canada, Japan, and Taiwan, plus franchise stores across Asia, Europe, Latin America, the Middle East, and Africa. Its customers shop through stores, websites, and third-party arrangements.

40533.text: General Dynamics is an aerospace and defense company providing business jets through Gulfstream, ship construction and repair, combat systems and technology solutions. The company operates in business aviation and defense markets with facilities on four continents including Savannah, Georgia.

4127.text: Skyworks Solutions develops and manufactures analog and mixed-signal semiconductor products for applications including aerospace, automotive, broadband, cellular, defense, industrial and smartphones. The company operates worldwide with facilities in Asia, Europe and North America. It serves OEMs and smartphone providers in wireless connectivity markets.

42888.text: Graco manufactures equipment and systems for managing and applying fluids and coatings in industrial and commercial applications. The company operates globally with manufacturing in the United States and multiple international locations. It serves manufacturing, processing, construction and maintenance industries through three business segments.

47111.text: Hershey is a global confectionery leader producing chocolate, non-chocolate confectionery, and salty snacks under brands like Hershey's and Reese's. The company operates in approximately 65 countries with manufacturing in North America, Mexico, Brazil, India, and Malaysia. Customers include wholesalers, grocery stores, mass merchandisers, and vending companies.

47217.text: HP makes personal computers, printers, 3D printing equipment, supplies, and related services and subscriptions, plus security software. It operates in more than 170 countries. It serves enterprise, public sector, small and medium-sized business, and consumer customers, selling directly and through resellers, retailers and system integrators.

49071.text: Humana provides health insurance and healthcare services, primarily through federal government contracts for Medicare and Medicaid beneficiaries. It offers HMO, PPO, and POS plans, pharmacy services, and clinical programs across the United States. The company served approximately 15 million medical benefit plan members as of December 2025.

50471.text: ReposiTrak is a Software-as-a-Service company operating a business-to-business e-commerce, compliance, traceability and supply chain management platform. The platform serves retailers, wholesalers, distributors and their suppliers, helping them manage supply chain programs, compliance documents and product ordering.

50863.text: Intel designs and manufactures semiconductor products (CPUs and related solutions) for computing devices and services. It supplies OEMs, ODMs, and other manufacturers globally, with products serving consumers, enterprises, governments, and educational organizations. Intel also offers foundry services to external customers.

55785.text: Kimberly-Clark makes essential consumer and professional products from fibers, nonwovens and absorbency, including Huggies, Kleenex, Scott and Kotex brands. Its brands serve people in more than 175 countries and territories. Customers include supermarkets, mass merchandisers, drugstores and warehouse clubs, as well as distributors and professional users such as food service and lodging businesses.

57515.text: Marzetti (MZTI) manufactures and markets specialty food products, including sauces, dressings, frozen breads and yeast rolls, through Retail and Foodservice segments. It sells mainly in the United States through sales personnel, brokers and distributors. Retail customers include grocery stores, and Foodservice customers include national chain restaurants.

59255.text: Valhi is primarily a holding company whose majority-controlled subsidiary Kronos produces titanium dioxide (TiO2) pigments, a white pigment used in coatings, plastics and paper. Kronos sells to about 3,000 customers in 100 countries, mainly in Europe, North America and Asia Pacific. Its major customers include paint, plastics, decorative laminate and paper manufacturers.

59478.name: ELI LILLY & Co
59478.text: Eli Lilly discovers, develops, manufactures and markets human pharmaceutical products. It manufactures in the U.S., including Puerto Rico, Europe and Asia, and sells products in about 90 countries. Its customers include wholesalers, pharmacy benefit managers, insurers, hospitals and government institutions.

59527.text: Lincoln Electric is a global industrial machinery leader making arc welding equipment, cutting systems, wire feeders, and automation solutions. With operations in 20 countries, it serves manufacturers, fabricators, and integrators through distributors and direct sales.

60519.text: LPX manufactures high-performance building solutions including engineered wood siding and OSB structural panels across over 20 facilities in North and South America. It serves home builders, remodelers, retailers, and wholesalers.

6281.name: ANALOG DEVICES INC
6281.text: Analog Devices designs, manufactures and markets analog, mixed-signal and digital signal processing integrated circuits, including data converters, amplifiers, power management, RF ICs and sensors. It sells its ICs to customers worldwide across a wide range of applications.

6845.text: Apogee Enterprises provides architectural building products and services, including aluminum window, curtainwall and entrance systems, installation services, architectural glass, and coated materials for applications such as wall decor and museums. Its architectural customers are mainly glazing subcontractors and general contractors, and it primarily supplies customers in North America.

69633.text: NAPCO makes security products, including access control systems, door locks, intrusion and fire alarm systems, and video surveillance, and provides cellular communication services for alarm systems. It sells principally to independent distributors, dealers and installers, and serves commercial, residential, institutional, industrial and governmental applications.

69733.text: Nathan's Famous is a branded licensor, wholesaler and retailer of Nathan's World Famous hot dogs, crinkle-cut french fries and other products. Its products are marketed in thousands of locations across the US and in twenty foreign countries. Customers include supermarkets, mass merchandisers, club stores, and foodservice distributors and operators.

69891.text: National Beverage (FIZZ) makes and distributes sparkling waters, juices, energy drinks and carbonated soft drinks, including LaCroix, Rip It, Shasta and Faygo. Its primary market is the United States, with limited distribution in other countries. It sells to retailers, mass merchandisers, food-service distributors and schools.

700841.text: RCM Technologies (RCMT) provides business and technology solutions through specialty healthcare, engineering, life sciences, information technology and data management services. It serves clients in North America and Europe through about 27 offices. Its customers include Aerospace/Defense, Educational Institutions, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Manufacturing & Distribution, the Public Sector and Technology companies.

701719.text: Envela (ELA) is a recommerce and recycling company with two segments. The consumer segment sells pre-owned luxury goods, including fine jewelry, diamonds, luxury watches and bullion. The commercial segment provides IT asset disposition, product returns and electronics de-manufacturing and metal reclamation services. Its consumer segment sells to individual customers and its commercial segment works with businesses.

703351.name: BRINKER INTERNATIONAL, INC
703351.text: Brinker owns, develops, operates and franchises the Chili's Grill & Bar and Maggiano's Little Italy restaurant brands. Chili's has restaurants in the United States, 28 other countries and two U.S. territories, and Maggiano's is a national brand. Maggiano's serves guests for everyday lunch and dinner, special events and celebrations.

707549.text: Lam Research is a global supplier of wafer fabrication equipment and services to the semiconductor industry, including deposition, etch and clean products, spares and upgrades. It is headquartered in Fremont, California, with facilities in Asia, Europe and the United States. Its customers include memory, foundry and integrated device manufacturers.

708781.text: Cass provides payment and information processing services, such as freight invoice rating, payment processing and utility invoice payment, to large manufacturing, distribution and retail enterprises across the U.S. Its bank, Cass Commercial Bank, serves privately held businesses in the St. Louis area, restaurant franchises and faith-based ministries.

715153.name: HONDA MOTOR CO LTD
715153.text: Honda develops, manufactures and markets motorcycles, automobiles and power products globally. Its finance subsidiaries in Japan, the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, Brazil and Thailand offer retail lending, leasing to customers and wholesale financing to dealers.

717423.name: MURPHY OIL CORP
717423.text: Murphy Oil is a global oil and natural gas exploration and production company with onshore and offshore operations. It produces crude oil, natural gas and natural gas liquids primarily in the U.S. and Canada, and explores worldwide. Its 2025 production was in the U.S., Canada and Brunei.

719955.text: Williams-Sonoma is an omni-channel specialty retailer of home products under brands including Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn and West Elm, sold through e-commerce, catalogs, stores and business-to-business. It operates in the U.S., Puerto Rico, Canada, Australia and the U.K., with franchisees in Mexico, South Korea, India and the Philippines. It serves consumers and business customers.

723254.text: Cintas provides uniforms, facility services, mats, restroom supplies, first aid and safety products, and workplace water services to businesses. The company operates primarily in the United States, Canada, and Latin America, serving over one million businesses of all types and sizes.

723531.text: Paychex is an HCM company providing comprehensive technology and advisory solutions in HR, payroll processing, employee benefits, and insurance. It serves approximately 840,000 customers in the U.S. and parts of Europe, about 800,000 of which are payroll clients. Over 60% of revenue comes from solutions beyond payroll processing.

724910.text: NVE develops and sells spintronic devices, including magnetic sensors and couplers used to acquire and transmit data. Its products are used in applications such as factory automation, medical devices and power conversion. It relies on distributors in more than 75 countries and on several large customers, including Abbott Laboratories.

730263.text: THOR Industries is the largest manufacturer of recreational vehicles in the world, producing towable and motorized RVs and related parts in the U.S. and Europe. It sells primarily to independent, non-franchise dealers in the United States, Canada and Europe.

730272.text: Repligen develops and commercializes bioprocessing technologies and systems for biological drug manufacturing. The company operates manufacturing sites across the United States and in seven countries outside the U.S. It serves biopharmaceutical companies, contract manufacturers, and other life science companies.

731012.text: HCSG provides housekeeping, laundry, linen and dietary management services to healthcare facilities, including nursing homes, retirement complexes, rehabilitation centers and hospitals. It serves about 2,800 facilities across the continental United States. Its customers are primarily long-term care providers.

731766.text: UnitedHealth Group provides health care and well-being services through Optum (health services, data analytics and pharmacy) and UnitedHealthcare (health benefits). It serves patients, consumers, employers, care providers and government entities.

731802.text: Atmos Energy is a natural gas-only distributor delivering natural gas through regulated sales and transportation arrangements. It serves about 3.4 million residential, commercial, public authority and industrial customers in eight states located primarily in the South. It also operates one of the largest intrastate pipelines in Texas.

737758.text: Toro designs, manufactures, and sells professional turf maintenance equipment, irrigation systems, landscaping equipment, snow and ice management products, and residential yard equipment. The company markets products worldwide through distributors, dealers, retailers, and equipment rental centers. It serves professional users including golf courses, sports fields, landscape contractors, and homeowners.

745732.text: Ross Stores operates two off-price retail apparel and home fashion brands: Ross Dress for Less and dd's DISCOUNTS. With 1,904 Ross locations across 44 states and territories and 363 dd's DISCOUNTS stores across 22 states, the company serves value-driven customers through discounted brand name merchandise.

749098.text: MGA is based in Aurora, Ontario, Canada and operates in the motor vehicle parts and accessories industry. The excerpt provided contains only filing cover pages without detailed business description.

751365.text: Virco designs, produces and distributes movable educational furniture, including tables, desks, chairs and storage, for the preschool through 12th grade market in the United States. It operates from facilities in Torrance, California and Conway, Arkansas. Its customers include schools, colleges, convention centers, hospitality venues, government facilities, places of worship, and wholesalers and retailers serving these markets.

75362.text: PACCAR is a multinational company that designs, manufactures and distributes light-, medium- and heavy-duty commercial trucks under the Kenworth, Peterbilt and DAF nameplates, and distributes aftermarket truck parts. Its financial services segment provides finance and leasing to customers and dealers. Its operations span the United States, Europe, Australia, Brazil, Canada and Mexico, and its trucks are sold to independent dealers.

763744.text: LCI Industries (LCII) supplies engineered components, such as chassis, furniture, windows, appliances, and towing accessories, to the RV, transportation, marine, and housing industries. It operates over 100 manufacturing facilities in North America and Europe. Customers include OEMs such as RV makers, plus aftermarket buyers served through dealers, distributors, and online sales.

764180.text: Altria makes cigarettes, cigars, oral tobacco and nicotine pouches, and e-vapor products through subsidiaries such as Philip Morris USA and UST. It operates primarily within the United States. It sells mainly to wholesalers, distributors and large retail organizations, including chain stores.

764401.text: Insteel Industries manufactures steel wire reinforcing products for concrete construction, including prestressed concrete strand and welded wire reinforcement. It sells mainly to manufacturers of concrete products, and to a lesser extent to distributors, rebar fabricators and contractors. Its eleven manufacturing facilities are in the U.S., with sales nationwide and, to a much lesser extent, into Canada, Mexico and Central and South America.

764478.text: Best Buy sells computing, mobile phones, consumer electronics, appliances and entertainment products, plus services such as installation, repair and warranty services. It operates in the U.S. and Canada through stores, online and in customers' homes. It serves customers who shop online, in its stores or through in-home services.

769520.name: MIDDLEBY Corp
769520.text: Middleby designs, manufactures and services commercial foodservice equipment and food processing equipment. Its foodservice equipment is used by quick-service and full-service restaurants, ghost kitchens, convenience stores, supermarkets, hotels and other institutions. Its food processing equipment serves producers of protein and bakery products.

771266.text: Kopin is a Delaware corporation headquartered in Westborough, Massachusetts, that makes microdisplays, including LCD, OLED and MicroLED displays, and application-specific optical subsystems. It has operations in the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Europe. Its customers are in defense, enterprise, industrial, consumer and medical sectors.

772406.text: CRUS is a leader in low-power, high-precision mixed-signal processing solutions for mobile and consumer applications. It designs audio products including amplifiers, codecs, and converters, plus high-performance mixed-signal products such as camera controllers, haptics solutions, and power management ICs. CRUS operates globally and primarily serves major electronics manufacturers including Apple.

77360.text: Pentair is a water solutions company with three operating segments: Flow (pump and fluid treatment products), Water Solutions (residential and commercial water products), and Pool (pool equipment). The company serves global residential, commercial and industrial markets through wholesalers, retailers, end users and original equipment manufacturers.

773840.text: Honeywell is an integrated operating company that blends physical products with software for aerospace, building automation, industrial automation, process automation and process technology. It serves a broad range of industries and geographies worldwide. Its Aerospace Technologies segment sells principally to the U.S. government and prime contractors, including the U.S. Department of Defense.

779152.text: Jack Henry & Associates provides financial technology solutions including core data processing systems and complementary services to community and regional banks and credit unions. It serves over 7,200 financial institutions with on-premise and cloud solutions.

789019.text: Microsoft develops software, cloud services (Azure, Microsoft 365), AI products, gaming consoles, and devices. It provides productivity and collaboration solutions, cloud infrastructure, and gaming services for individuals, businesses, and enterprises.

789933.text: NACCO Industries (NC) operates three segments: Utility Coal Mining, which supplies coal under long-term mining contracts to power generators; Contract Mining, which provides specialized contract mining services; and Minerals and Royalties, which holds mineral and royalty interests. It also has mitigation and power development businesses. NACCO says its businesses operate exclusively in the U.S. Its customers include power generation companies and aggregates producers.

790051.text: Carlisle supplies building envelope products including roofing membranes and weatherproofing solutions through its Carlisle Construction Materials and Carlisle Weatherproofing Technologies segments. The company manufactures in the United States and Europe. It serves commercial construction and remodeling customers seeking energy-efficient building solutions.

793952.text: Harley-Davidson (HOG) designs, manufactures and sells motorcycles, with parts, accessories, apparel and trademark licensing, plus LiveWire electric motorcycles and HDMC financial services. HDMC sells globally, including the U.S., Canada, EMEA, Asia Pacific and Latin America, mainly through independent dealers. Its retail customers are riders and enthusiasts.

795266.text: KB Home (KBH) builds single-family homes, townhomes and condominiums in nine U.S. states, mainly for first-time and first move-up buyers. Its financial services arm offers insurance and title services to its homebuyers in certain markets.

796343.text: Adobe provides creative software solutions and platforms for content creation, design, and marketing powered by AI. The company serves business professionals, consumers, creative professionals and marketing professionals globally. Adobe's product portfolio spans document productivity, creative applications, and enterprise marketing solutions including its Experience Platform.

79879.text: PPG manufactures and distributes paints, coatings, and specialty products for industrial, automotive, aerospace, marine, and consumer applications. It operates in more than 50 countries, serving original equipment manufacturers, contractors, and consumers.

802481.text: PPC produces, processes and distributes fresh, frozen and value-added chicken and pork products across the U.S., U.K., continental Europe, Mexico and over 120 countries. It serves foodservice operators, chain restaurants and retail customers including grocery chains and warehouse clubs.

804328.text: QCOM develops and supplies integrated circuit platforms and licenses wireless technology intellectual property for mobile, automotive, and IoT applications. It serves device manufacturers globally.

810136.text: Photronics (PLAB) is a manufacturer of photomasks, high-precision quartz or glass plates containing circuit images used to fabricate integrated circuits and flat panel displays. It operates eleven manufacturing facilities in Taiwan, China, South Korea, the United States and Europe. The excerpt describes its customers as semiconductor and flat panel display makers, with sales support for non-U.S. customers, mainly in Asia.

811809.text: BHP is a mining company producing copper, iron ore, steelmaking coal, and potash from its Jansen project, where first production is expected in mid-CY2027. Its operations include Pilbara iron ore, Olympic Dam in South Australia and Escondida in Chile. It works closely with steelmaking customers.

815556.text: Fastenal sells industrial and construction supplies through 1,595 locations across 25 countries supported by 15 distribution centers. It serves business customers through physical sites and technologies including vending devices and managed inventory programs. The company offers nine major product lines with focus on fasteners and industrial supplies.

820313.text: Amphenol designs, manufactures and markets electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors, interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and specialty cable. The company operates three business segments globally serving Communications Solutions, Harsh Environment Solutions and Interconnect and Sensor Systems markets.

820318.text: Coherent (Coherent Corp.) develops, manufactures and markets lasers, transceivers, optical and optoelectronic devices, modules, systems and engineered materials for datacenter, communications and industrial markets. It is headquartered in Saxonburg, Pennsylvania, with production and R&D operations in the U.S., China, Finland, Germany, Malaysia, Singapore, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, the UK and other countries. Customers include optical component makers, networking equipment manufacturers, datacenter operators and telecom service providers, plus semiconductor and display capital equipment makers.

821002.text: G-III designs, sources, distributes and markets apparel and accessories under owned brands such as DKNY, Donna Karan, Karl Lagerfeld and Vilebrequin, and licensed brands such as Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger. It sells at wholesale, through its own digital platforms and retail stores, and to retailers including Macy's, Costco, Kohl's and Ross Stores for private-label collections.

822663.text: Interparfums manufactures, markets and distributes prestige fragrances under brands such as Boucheron, Coach, Jimmy Choo, GUESS and Hollister, using third-party fillers rather than owned plants. Its European operations, based in Paris, distribute products in over 120 countries. Macy's is its top retail customer.

827054.text: Microchip develops, manufactures and sells embedded control semiconductor solutions for a wide variety of applications, selling primarily to distributors and direct customers worldwide.

829224.text: Starbucks roasts and retails specialty coffee, handcrafted beverages and food through company-operated and licensed stores, and sells coffee and tea through grocery and foodservice channels. It operates in 89 markets. It serves consumers in its stores and through these grocery and foodservice channels.

831641.text: Tetra Tech is a global consulting and engineering services company specializing in water, environment and sustainable infrastructure solutions. The company operates through two segments serving U.S. government clients (federal, state and local), international development agencies and commercial clients across more than 100 countries.

835403.text: Diageo is a spirits company with a portfolio of brands, including ready-to-drink (RTD) cocktails, Smirnoff Ice and Guinness. It operates in five regions, with North America as its largest market. It sells to wholesalers and distributors, which also sell other brands.

836690.text: IA designs, manufactures and services avionics products and flight solutions for commercial air transport, business aviation and military aircraft, including flight deck displays, navigation and sensor systems. It operates a facility in Exton, Pennsylvania, and its customers include the U.S. government, Boeing, Lockheed Martin and Pilatus.

844551.text: Woodside (WDS) is an Australian energy company listed on the ASX and NYSE that produces and holds reserves of crude oil and natural gas. Its proved reserves and production are in fields in Australia, Senegal and the United States Gulf of America.

84839.text: Rollins is a global pest and wildlife control services company with over 800 locations in approximately 70 countries. It serves more than two million residential and commercial customers through brands including Orkin and Clark Pest Control.

851205.text: Deckers Outdoor designs, markets, and distributes footwear, apparel, and accessories under three core brands: HOKA, UGG, and Teva. The company operates globally through wholesale distribution to retailers and independent distributors, and direct-to-consumer channels including e-commerce and 203 company-owned retail stores as of March 2026.

851520.text: Exponent is a science and engineering consulting firm that solves complex technical problems across more than 90 disciplines, including engineering, data sciences and health sciences. It serves clients around the world in sectors such as chemical, consumer products, energy, government, life sciences, insurance, manufacturing and technology, often engaged by corporations, law firms or insurers.

855658.text: Lattice Semiconductor develops low-power programmable logic devices and FPGAs for edge-to-cloud applications as a fabless provider. The company serves global markets in communications and computing, industrial and automotive, and consumer sectors, with customers building data centers, 5G infrastructure, IoT devices, and automotive systems.

858877.name: CISCO SYSTEMS, INC.
858877.text: Cisco designs and sells networking, security, collaboration and observability technologies, including hardware, software, AI-powered digital infrastructure and related services. It manages its business across the Americas, EMEA, and APJC. Its customers include businesses of all sizes, public institutions, governments, service providers and hyperscalers.

863064.text: Rio Tinto is a metals and mining company domiciled in the UK and Australia. The report focuses on iron ore, copper, aluminium and lithium, and includes the Simandou project in Guinea.

865752.text: Monster Beverage develops, markets and distributes energy drinks, craft beers, flavored malt beverages and hard seltzers through four operating segments. Based in Corona, California, the company sells primarily to bottlers, distributors, and retail chains in the U.S. and internationally.

866291.text: Allegro Microsystems designs and manufactures sensor integrated circuits and power management ICs for automotive, industrial, and data center applications. Its magnetic sensor and power IC portfolio enables motion control, sensing, and power management. The company serves global automotive OEMs and suppliers, data center operators, and industrial robotics manufacturers.

866787.text: AutoZone is a leading retailer of automotive replacement parts and accessories across the Americas. As of August 2025, it operated 6,627 stores in the US, 883 in Mexico, and 147 in Brazil. It serves retail customers and provides commercial parts delivery and credit to repair garages, dealers, service stations, and fleet owners.

866829.text: HOS is listed on the NYSE, but the excerpt describes Helix Energy Solutions Group (ticker HLX). It provides offshore energy services, including well intervention, robotics and decommissioning, mainly in the Gulf of America, Brazil, the North Sea, West Africa and Asia Pacific. Its customers include oil and gas producers, pipeline companies and renewable energy companies.

8670.text: ADP is a global leader in Human Capital Management solutions serving over 1.1 million clients across 140+ countries. The company provides payroll processing, benefits administration, talent management, HR outsourcing and workforce management solutions. ADP serves businesses ranging from small enterprises to Fortune 500 companies.

872589.text: Regeneron is a fully integrated biotechnology company that invents, develops, manufactures and commercializes medicines for patients with serious diseases including eye conditions, cancer, and inflammatory disorders. The company works with collaborators and licensees on product development and commercialization.

874716.text: IDEXX develops, manufactures and distributes diagnostic products and provides laboratory services for companion animal and livestock veterinarians, biomedical researchers, and water testing customers across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

874866.text: CorVel is a nationwide provider of medical cost containment and managed care services for workers' compensation, auto insurance and group health claims. Its services include claims management, bill review, PPO networks, utilization and case management, and pharmacy services. It serves insurance companies, third-party administrators, government entities and self-administered employers.

875320.text: VRTX is a global biotechnology company with marketed medicines for cystic fibrosis, sickle cell disease, and beta thalassemia. It sells medicines through specialty distributors and pharmacies globally.

879169.text: Incyte is a global biopharmaceutical company developing therapies in hematology, oncology, and inflammation. Approved products include JAKAFI for myelofibrosis and graft-versus-host disease, ICLUSIG for chronic myeloid leukemia, and MONJUVI for lymphoma. The company operates globally with headquarters in the United States, Switzerland, Japan, and Canada.

879585.text: ATN provides fixed and mobile telecommunications, broadband, and carrier communications services, including fiber transport, in rural and remote markets. It operates primarily in the western US and Alaska, and internationally in Bermuda and the Caribbean. Customers include residential, business and government customers, and carrier customers.

88121.text: Seaboard is a diversified company in pork production and processing, biofuel, commodity trading and grain processing, cargo shipping and power generation. It operates in the U.S., Africa, South America, the Caribbean and the Dominican Republic. Pork is sold to processors, foodservice operators, distributors and grocery stores; power goes to government-owned distribution companies in the Dominican Republic.

88205.text: SPX Technologies offers HVAC solutions including cooling, heating, and ventilation products, as well as detection and measurement equipment for infrastructure inspection and maintenance. The company serves industrial, institutional, and commercial customers, including utilities, telecommunications providers, and government agencies.

882184.text: D.R. Horton is the largest homebuilder in the United States, constructing and selling homes across 126 markets in 36 states. The company also provides mortgage financing and title services to homebuyers.

883241.text: Synopsys provides electronic design automation software and hardware used to design and test integrated circuits, plus silicon IP, simulation and analysis software (including Ansys) and design services. Its customers include chip and system engineers and software developers, and Ansys products are used across industries such as high-tech, aerospace and defense, and automotive.

884269.text: Alpha Pro Tech makes disposable protective apparel and infection control products, and construction weatherization products such as housewrap and roof underlayment. Its executive offices are in Aurora, Ontario, and its products are distributed principally in the United States. Its customers include construction supply and roofing distributors, pharmaceutical, medical device and semiconductor manufacturers, and medical and dental distributors.

885245.text: Buckle is a retailer of medium to better-priced casual apparel, footwear, and accessories. As of January 31, 2026, it operated 440 stores in 42 U.S. states under the Buckle and Buckle Youth names. It serves fashion-conscious men, women, and kids.

886128.text: FuelCell is a clean energy technology company that manufactures and sells molten carbonate fuel cell systems for baseload power, carbon capture and thermal energy. It markets its products primarily in the U.S., Canada, the EU, the UK, South Korea, Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand. Customers include utilities, independent power producers and data centers.

888746.text: CCU (Compañía Cervecerías Unidas) produces and sells beer, soft drinks, mineral water, wine, pisco and rum. It operates in Chile and Argentina and sells in Bolivia, Colombia, Paraguay and Uruguay. It sells to retail, supermarket and wholesale customers.

88941.text: SMTC designs and manufactures high-performance semiconductors for data center networking, IoT connectivity, and cellular infrastructure. Its products serve original equipment manufacturers, IoT device makers, and enterprises across infrastructure, consumer and industrial markets globally.

889971.text: LightPath makes infrared and precision optical components, assemblies and infrared camera systems, serving defense, public safety, industrial, commercial, telecom and medical customers. It has facilities in the United States and Latvia, with headquarters in Orlando, Florida.

894627.text: VAALCO Energy is an independent oil, natural gas and NGL company engaged in acquisition, exploration, development and production. Its assets are located in Gabon, Egypt, Cote d'Ivoire, Equatorial Guinea and Nigeria, and it has agreed to sell its Canadian operations. The excerpt does not describe its customers.

895447.text: Shoe Carnival is an omnichannel footwear retailer for the family, selling national brands such as Nike, Skechers and adidas. It operates 426 stores under the Shoe Carnival and Shoe Station banners across 35 states and Puerto Rico, plus online shopping. Shoe Carnival stores mainly serve moderate to low-income families, while Shoe Station targets a more affluent footwear customer.

896264.text: USANA Health Sciences (USNA) develops and manufactures nutritional supplements, functional foods and personal care products. Its core business sells through direct selling, and its Hiya segment sells children's health products direct-to-consumer, with a subscription model. It operates in 25 geographic markets worldwide, with China as its largest market. Its customers are Brand Partners and Preferred Customers in the core business, and Hiya subscribers in the U.S.

896878.text: Intuit is a global financial technology platform serving approximately 93 million consumers, small and mid-market businesses, and accountants. The company provides tax, accounting, financial management and marketing solutions through products including TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma and Mailchimp.

898173.text: O'Reilly Automotive is a specialty retailer of automotive aftermarket parts, tools, supplies and equipment. It operates 6,447 stores in the United States and Puerto Rico, plus locations in Mexico and Canada. The company serves both do-it-yourself customers and professional service providers.

908315.text: Winmark (WINA) is a franchisor of five resale retail brands: Plato's Closet, Once Upon A Child, Play It Again Sports, Style Encore and Music Go Round. Its franchisees sell gently used and some new merchandise, with 1,378 franchised stores in the United States and Canada. The stores serve consumers who buy and sell used goods.

9092.text: Badger Meter is a global provider of water management solutions, including flow meters, water quality and leak detection sensors, communication endpoints and cloud software. Utility Water products are sold to water utilities, and Flow Instrumentation products to commercial and industrial customers. Its largest geographic market is North America, primarily the United States.

909832.text: Costco operates membership warehouses and e-commerce sites selling nationally-branded and private-label foods, non-foods, fresh foods and gasoline, plus pharmacy and optical services. It operates in the U.S., Puerto Rico, Canada, Mexico, Japan, the U.K., Korea, Australia, Taiwan, China, Spain, France and Sweden, among other countries. It serves paying members, who pay an annual fee.

910329.text: Medifast is a health and wellness company offering a coach-guided lifestyle system with science-based weight loss plans and products. Its independent coaches support clients and market its products, primarily through word-of-mouth and social media. Products are shipped directly to clients.

910521.text: Deck designs, markets and distributes footwear, apparel and accessories under the HOKA, UGG and Teva brands for casual lifestyle and high-performance use. It operates globally through wholesale retailers and distributors, as well as direct-to-consumer e-commerce and retail stores.

91142.text: A. O. Smith manufactures and markets residential and commercial water heaters, boilers, heat pumps, tanks and water treatment products through two segments: North America (78% of sales) and Rest of World. The company serves residential and commercial markets through wholesale distribution, retail channels and direct-to-consumer sales.

912093.name: VIAVI SOLUTIONS INC.
912093.text: Viavi Solutions is a global leader in test and measurement and optical technologies, providing test, monitoring, and resilient Position, Navigation and Timing solutions. Its products also include optical security pigments and 3D sensing technologies. Its customers include telecommunications service providers, network equipment makers, semiconductor vendors, cloud operators, and military and aerospace organizations, such as AT&T, Cisco Systems, Ericsson, and Verizon.

912615.text: Urbn operates global lifestyle brands including Anthropologie, Free People, Urban Outfitters and Nuuly, offering fashion apparel, accessories, home goods and apparel subscription services. It sells through Company-owned stores in North America and Europe, franchisee stores in the Middle East, and digital channels.

912767.text: UFP Industries manufactures wood and composite products through three business segments: Retail Solutions, Packaging, and Construction. Operating across the United States, Mexico, Canada, Spain, India and Australia, it serves retailers, distributors, building materials companies, and industrial customers.

914475.text: Neurocrine Biosciences is a biopharmaceutical company developing treatments for neurological, psychiatric, and endocrine disorders. It markets FDA-approved products INGREZZA and CRENESSITY for tardive dyskinesia, Huntington's disease, and congenital adrenal hyperplasia, primarily in the U.S.

916365.text: Tractor Supply is the largest rural lifestyle retailer in the U.S., operating 2,602 stores in 49 states and online. It sells farm, ranch, pet, and garden products to recreational farmers, ranchers, homesteaders, and rural consumers.

91767.text: SON designs and manufactures engineered and sustainable packaging across 265 locations in 37 countries. The company serves global brands in food, beverage, household, personal care, and pharmaceutical industries.

920371.text: Simpson Manufacturing designs and manufactures structural solutions for wood and concrete construction, including connectors, fasteners, and lateral-force resisting systems. It serves residential and commercial construction markets across North America and Europe, as well as OEMs, component manufacturers, and national retailers.

920760.text: LEN is one of the largest U.S. homebuilders and also originates residential mortgage loans and provides title insurance. The company operates in over 20 states, primarily selling single-family and multifamily homes to first-time, move-up, active adult and luxury homebuyers.

922621.text: Erie Indemnity acts as attorney-in-fact for the Erie Insurance Exchange, providing policy issuance, claims handling and investment management services. The Exchange writes property and casualty insurance including auto, homeowners, commercial multi-peril and workers compensation through independent agencies.

924613.text: Nokia provides network equipment through two segments, Network Infrastructure, which includes optical, IP and fixed networks, and Mobile Infrastructure, which covers mobile networks. Its customers include telecommunication providers, mission critical enterprise customers and AI & Cloud customers.

924719.text: Smith-Midland manufactures and sells precast concrete products, including SlenderWall, Sierra Wall and Easi-Set utility vaults, and rents highway barriers. Its precast and barrier rental customers are mainly general contractors and federal, state and local transportation authorities in the Mid-Atlantic, Northeastern, Midwestern and Southeastern U.S. Its licensing subsidiary also licenses its products nationwide and internationally.

927653.text: McKesson is a healthcare services company distributing pharmaceutical drugs and medical-surgical supplies. It operates four segments: North American Pharmaceutical (drug distribution in U.S. and Canada), Oncology & Multispecialty, Prescription Technology Solutions, and Medical-Surgical Solutions. The company serves pharmacies, hospitals, healthcare providers, and biopharma companies.

928876.text: Tower is a specialty foundry manufacturing processed wafers based on customers' design specifications. It operates facilities in Israel, the U.S., Japan, and Italy, serving semiconductor companies and fabless companies in markets including data centers, automotive, industrial, and medical devices.

929869.text: RELX is a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools, now provided almost exclusively in electronic format, across four segments: Risk, Scientific, Technical & Medical, Legal and Exhibitions. It serves professional and business customers in more than 180 countries and territories, with offices in about 40 countries.

930157.text: Rentokil (RTO) is a UK public limited company providing pest control and hygiene services, including termite and pest management through its U.S. Terminix business. As of 31 December 2025 it operated 2,081 facilities in 90 countries. Its services protect people from pest-borne disease and the reputations of customers' brands.

932787.text: STMicroelectronics (STM) is a global semiconductor company that designs and manufactures power, analog, sensor, MEMS and microcontroller products. It serves automotive, industrial, personal electronics, and communications equipment, computers and peripherals customers. Its head offices are in Schiphol, the Netherlands, and its operational headquarters are in Geneva, Switzerland.

93389.text: Standard Motor Products makes and distributes premium replacement parts for the automotive aftermarket, including engine management, electrical and safety, and temperature control parts, and provides custom-engineered solutions for vehicle and equipment manufacturers. It sells mainly to retailers, warehouse distributors and original equipment manufacturers in the United States, Europe, Canada, Mexico and other foreign countries.

935703.text: Dollar Tree operates approximately 9,000 discount retail stores across 48 U.S. states and the District of Columbia, plus 275 stores in Canada. The company carries approximately 8,400 items including consumables and discretionary merchandise, serving consumers through stores and online platforms.

936468.text: Lockheed Martin is an aerospace and defense company operating four segments: Aeronautics (military aircraft), Missiles and Fire Control, Rotary and Mission Systems (helicopters and defense systems), and Space. The company designs and manufactures advanced military aircraft, missiles, defense systems and related technologies. Its principal customers are U.S. Government agencies and international allies.

937098.text: TriNet provides HR solutions for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs), including PEO and ASO services, employee benefits, payroll and payroll tax administration, and compliance consulting. Its targeted industry verticals include technology, financial services, life sciences, nonprofit, professional services and main street businesses.

937966.text: ASML makes lithography systems, with holistic lithography as its core business, and shipped an i-line system for advanced packaging in 2025. Its main campus is in the Veldhoven area of the Netherlands, and it also has an office in Korea and a technical training academy in Phoenix.

940944.name: DARDEN RESTAURANTS INC
940944.text: Darden Restaurants is a full-service restaurant company operating brands including Olive Garden, LongHorn Steakhouse, Ruth's Chris, and Yard House. As of May 31, 2026, it owned and operated 2,202 restaurants in the United States. Its brands operate principally in the U.S., and it does not rely on any major customers for sales.

943819.text: ResMed is a global leader in digital health and cloud-connected medical devices for sleep and breathing health. Products include CPAP systems for sleep apnea, ventilation devices, masks, diagnostics, and cloud-based health applications software. It operates in more than 140 countries serving patients, clinicians, and healthcare providers.

945983.text: Climb Global Solutions is a value-added IT distributor. Its Distribution segment (Climb Channel Solutions) sells software and technology products to corporate resellers, value added resellers, consultants and systems integrators worldwide. Its Solutions segment (Grey Matter) sells IT products and services directly to end users. The company operates distribution facilities in Millersville, Maryland and Dublin, Ireland.

94845.text: Levi Strauss is one of the world's largest apparel companies, designing and marketing jeans, casual and dress pants, activewear, tops and jackets under Levi's, Levi Strauss Signature and Beyond Yoga brands. The company sells to approximately 120 countries through direct-to-consumer channels, wholesale customers and licensees.

97210.name: TERADYNE, INC
97210.text: Teradyne provides automated test equipment for semiconductors, wireless products, data storage and other electronics, along with collaborative robotic arms and autonomous mobile robots. Its robotics customers include manufacturing, logistics and industrial companies, and its test sales are concentrated among a limited number of major customers.

97476.text: Texas Instruments designs and manufactures semiconductors for electronics designers and manufacturers worldwide. Its products include analog and embedded processing semiconductors used in industrial, automotive, data center and communications applications. TI serves over 100,000 customers.

97745.name: THERMO FISHER SCIENTIFIC INC.
97745.text: Thermo Fisher provides reagents, instruments, consumables, analytical instruments, diagnostic products and pharmaceutical services. Its customers include pharmaceutical and biotech companies, hospitals and clinical diagnostic labs, universities, research institutions and government agencies.
